# Hello World, I’m Aline!

<div class="home-text-left">

I’ve spent **4+ years in industry** building and optimizing ML systems, and I have a **Master’s focused on Deep Reinforcement Learning**. But not really understanding these systems’ **internal behavior** has always annoyed me. And this discomfort only grows as these systems scale.  

I’ve recently started studying **mechanistic interpretability**. And this site is my attempt to document a **structured learning path**, moving towards safety-relevant mechanistic studies.  

It is a **living research log**! On the left, you’ll find a roadmap of my mechanistic interpretability journey,
which you can use to navigate through the different phases and experiments.
